shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json AGENTS.md 2>/dev/null; ls -R .agents | head -50

grep -n -i -B2 -A12 "table\|data grid" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -120; echo ----; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; echo ----; find src __agent_eval__ -type f | head; cat src/* 2>/dev/null | head -60; cat index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts

grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Table withTableSorting withTableSelection Pagination 2>&1 | head -60

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls build/esm/components/Table/ build/esm/components/Table/hoc 2>&1; cat build/esm/components/Table/Table.d.ts; cat build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.d.ts build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.d.ts; grep -n "Table\|Pagination" build/esm/components/index.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat Pagination/Pagination.d.ts | grep -v "^\s*$" | head -70; grep -n "meta\|sort\b\|defaultSortOrder\|disableDataSorting" Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.js | head -40; grep -n "ids\|selectedIds" Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.js | head -30
